repos.name: AI-Law-Sentiment
repos.description: This project tracks and analyzes public sentiment toward artificial intelligence regulation across online communities. The goal is to produce an open, reproducible dataset that documents how public opinion on AI governance evolves over time. Findings will be published openly on GitHub and used to support peer-reviewed academic research.
